# Vanbelle Law Boutique

> Award-winning Brussels-based boutique law firm specializing in international tax, corporate law, real estate, and global mobility services.

Vanbelle Law Boutique is an international law firm headquartered in Brussels, Belgium, led by Jo Vanbelle. The firm serves clients across multiple jurisdictions through its boutique model and VB Alliance network, offering specialized expertise in tax planning, corporate transactions, real estate development, and expat services.

## Key Topics

- International Tax Law
- Corporate & Business Law
- Real Estate & Project Development
- Global Mobility & Expat Services
- Tax Planning & Optimization
- M&A & Company Incorporation
- Transfer Pricing
- Brussels-Based Law Firm
- Jo Vanbelle
- VB Alliance
- Belgium
- Cross-Border Legal Services
- Tax Dispute Resolution
- Pension Planning

## Core Services

- [(Inter)national tax](https://www.vanbellelaw.com/en/services/inter-national-tax): International tax advisory, dispute resolution, transfer pricing, and tax planning services.
- [Corporate and business law](https://www.vanbellelaw.com/en/services/corporate-and-business-law): Corporate and business law: M&A, company incorporation, contracts, compliance, and dispute resolution.
- [Real estate and project development](https://www.vanbellelaw.com/en/services/real-estate-and-project-development): Real estate and project development: Property transactions, litigation, financing, and tax optimization.
- [Global mobility](https://www.vanbellelaw.com/en/services/expats-and-migration): Global mobility services: Expat assistance, migration law, visa, tax compliance, and family law.
